10 °) ର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "118°"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "110°"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "140°"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "102°"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sum of angles on a straight line (Linear Pair) = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sum of ratio components = 7x + 5x = 12x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12x = 180° ⇒ x = 15°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Required value = (8 × 15°) − 10°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Required value = 120° − 10° = 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 110°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given: ∠QPA = 7x and ∠QPB = 5x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used: Sum of Linear Pair of angles = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Since AB is a straight line and PQ is a ray starting from P on AB:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ∠QPA + ∠QPB = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 7x + 5x = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 12x = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ x = 180° ÷ 12

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ x = 15°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      To find the value of (8x − 10°):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (8 × 15°) − 10°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 120° − 10°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 110°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Linear Pair Axiom

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If a ray stands on a line, then the sum of the two adjacent angles so formed is 180°. Such angles are called supplementary angles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Straight Angle

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      An angle whose measure is exactly 180° is called a straight angle, which forms a perfectly straight line.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Adjacent Angles

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Two angles are adjacent if they have a common vertex and a common arm, but no common interior points. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      एक सीधी रेखा पर कोणों का योग (रैखिक युग्म) = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अनुपात घटकों का योग = 7x + 5x = 12x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12x = 180° ⇒ x = 15°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अभीष्ट मान = (8 × 15°) − 10°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अभीष्ट मान = 120° − 10° = 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 110° है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है: ∠QPA = 7x और ∠QPB = 5x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र: कोणों के रैखिक युग्म का योग = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      चूंकि AB एक सीधी रेखा है और PQ, AB पर P से शुरू होने वाली एक किरण है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ∠QPA + ∠QPB = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 7x + 5x = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 12x = 180°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ x = 180° ÷ 12

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ x = 15°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (8x − 10°) का मान ज्ञात करने के लिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (8 × 15°) − 10°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 120° − 10°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 110° है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      रैखिक युग्म अभिगृहीत (Linear Pair Axiom)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      यदि एक किरण एक रेखा पर खड़ी हो, तो इस प्रकार बने दो आसन्न कोणों का योग 180° होता है। ऐसे कोणों को संपूरक कोण कहा जाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ऋजु कोण (Straight Angle)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      वह कोण जिसका माप ठीक 180° होता है, ऋजु कोण कहलाता है, जो एक पूर्णतः सीधी रेखा बनाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      आसन्न कोण (Adjacent Angles)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दो कोण आसन्न होते हैं यदि उनका एक उभयनिष्ठ शीर्ष और एक उभयनिष्ठ भुजा हो, लेकिन उनके कोई उभयनिष्ठ आंतरिक बिंदु न हों।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      కాబట్టి, వాటి మొత్తం తప్పనిసరిగా 180°కి సమానంగా ఉండాలి (సరళ రేఖ యొక్క లక్షణం).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      లెక్కలు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      కాబట్టి, ∠QPA + ∠QPB = 180° 7x + 5x = 180 12x = 180 x = 180 / 12 x = 15°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ఇప్పుడు సమీకరణంలో x = 15° విలువను ప్రతిక్షేపం చేయండి (8x - 10°):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      = 8 × 15° - 10° = 120° - 10° = 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      కాబట్టి, (8x - 10°) విలువ 110°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∠QPA आणि ∠QPB हे AB या एका सरळ रेषेवर आहेत.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      म्हणून, त्यांची बेरीज 180° (सरळ रेषेचे गुणधर्म) योग्य असणे आवश्यक आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      तर, ∠QPA + ∠QPB = 180° 7x + 5x = 180 12x = 180 x = 180 / 12 x = 15°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      आता x = 15° मूल्य (8x - 10°) या पदावलीमध्ये टाकल्यास:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      = 8 × 15° - 10° = 120° - 10° = 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      म्हणून, (8x - 10°) चे मूल्य 110° आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∠QPA এবং ∠QPB একটি সরলরেখা AB এর উপর অবস্থিত।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      অতএব, তাদের যোগফল অবশ্যই 180° (একটি সরল রেখার বৈশিষ্ট্য়) সমান হতে হবে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখন প্রদত্ত রাশি (8x - 10°)-তে x = 15° এর মান প্রতিস্থাপন করে পাই:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      = 8 × 15° - 10° = 120° - 10° = 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      সুতরাং, (8x - 10°) এর মান হল 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∠QPA ಮತ್ತು ∠QPB AB ನೇರ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      = 8 x 15° - 10° = 120° - 10° = 110°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\({\\left( {\\frac{5}{2}} \\right)^{ - 3}} \\times {\\left( {\\frac{{ - 3}}{4}} \\right)^4} \\div {\\left( {\\frac{3}{5}} \\right)^3} \\times {\\left( {\\frac{4}{5}} \\right)^2}\\\\\\)

"correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If (x + 5) is a factor, then substituting x = −5 must make the expression zero.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Expression: (−5)3 + 3(−5)2 + 4(−5) + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      −125 + 3(25) − 20 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      −145 + 75 + k = 0 ⇒ k − 70 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      k = 70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 70.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given: Polynomial P(x) = x3 + 3x2 + 4x + k and a factor (x + 5).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used: Factor Theorem states that if (x + a) is a factor of P(x), then P(−a) = 0.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Let the factor be x + 5 = 0, which gives x = −5.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Substitute x = −5 into the polynomial P(x):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ P(−5) = (−5)3 + 3(−5)2 + 4(−5) + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ −125 + 3(25) − 20 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ −125 + 75 − 20 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ (−125 − 20) + 75 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ −145 + 75 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ −70 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ k = 70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 70.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Factor Theorem

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A polynomial f(x) has a factor (x − a) if and only if f(a) = 0. This is a special case of the remainder theorem.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Remainder Theorem

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When a polynomial f(x) is divided by a linear divisor (x − a), the remainder of the division is f(a).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Synthetic Division

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A shorthand method of polynomial division, especially when dividing by a linear factor of the form (x − a).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Roots of Polynomials

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If x = r is a root of P(x) = 0, then (x − r) is exactly divisible by P(x), meaning the remainder is zero. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      यदि (x + 5) एक गुणनखंड है, तो x = −5 प्रतिस्थापित करने पर व्यंजक का मान शून्य होना चाहिए।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      व्यंजक: (−5)3 + 3(−5)2 + 4(−5) + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      −125 + 3(25) − 20 + k = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      −145 + 75 + k = 0 ⇒ k − 70 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      k = 70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 70 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      భావన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      కారణాంకం సిద్ధాంతం: f(x) అనేది n ≥ 1 యొక్క బహుపది మరియు 'a' ఏదైనా వాస్తవ సంఖ్య అయితే, f(a) = 0 అయితే (x - a) f(x) యొక్క కారణాంకం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      లెక్కింపు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ P(x) = x 3 + 3x 2 + 4x + k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (x + 5) అనేది P(x) యొక్క కారణాంకం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ P(-5) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ k విలువ 70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ P(x) = x3 + 3x2 + 4x + k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
