                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Global Education Monitoring (GEM) Report is an annual publication released by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The GEM Report was first published in 2016 and serves as a continuation of the earlier Education for All Global Monitoring Reports.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The primary objective of the GEM Report is to monitor the progress of education systems globally and assess the implementation of Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4), which aims to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The report provides a comprehensive analysis of global education trends, policies, and challenges, covering aspects like access, equity, quality, and financing of education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Each annual report has a specific theme. For instance, the 2023 GEM Report focuses on technology and education, addressing how digital tools can support learning and the challenges of digital divides.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • UNESCO: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations established in 1945 with its headquarters in Paris, France.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Its mission is to promote international collaboration in education, science, culture, and communication to contribute to peace and security.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • UNESCO is responsible for monitoring progress toward SDG 4 of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, which focuses on education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It works in areas such as literacy, teacher training, gender equality in education, and digital education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4): \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • SDG 4 is one of the 17 goals under the United Nations 2030 Agenda.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Its main aim is to “Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.”
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The goal focuses on aspects like universal primary and secondary education, eliminating gender disparities, improving literacy rates, and ensuring quality education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Global Education Monitoring (GEM) Report Themes: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Each year, the GEM Report focuses on a unique theme related to education. Examples of past themes include: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 2020: Inclusion and Education: All Means All.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 2021: Non-state actors in education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 2023: Technology and education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The themes address emerging challenges, including equity, financing, and the role of technology in education.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ವಿವಿಧ ರೀತಿಯ ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್‌ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದಂತೆ, ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I. “ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್” ಎಂಬ ಪದವನ್ನು ಹೆಪಟೋಟ್ರೋಪಿಕ್ ವೈರಸ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಪಿತ್ತಜನಕಾಂಗದ ಉರಿಯೂತಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    II. ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್ B ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್ D ಯ ಪ್ರಸರಣವು ಸೋಂಕಿತ ರಕ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲವು ದೈಹಿಕ ದ್ರವಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಡ್ಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದರಿಂದ ಸಂಭವಿಸಬಹುದು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    III. ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್ D ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್ A ಯಂತೆಯೇ ಕಲುಷಿತ ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಮೇಲೆ ನೀಡಲಾದ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿವೆ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "ಒಂದು ಮಾತ್ರ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "ಎರಡು ಮಾತ್ರ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮೂರು"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "ಯಾವುದು ಅಲ್ಲ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "ta": {"value": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    வெவ்வேறு வகையான ஹெபடைடிஸ் தொடர்பாக, பின்வரும் அறிக்கைகளைக் கவனியுங்கள்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I. \"ஹெபடைடிஸ்\" என்ற சொல் ஹெபடோட்ரோபிக் வைரஸ்களால் ஏற்படும் கல்லீரல் அழற்சிக்கு மட்டுமே பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    II. ஹெபடைடிஸ் பி மற்றும் ஹெபடைடிஸ் டி பரவுதல் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இரத்தம் மற்றும் சில உடல் திரவங்களுடன் தொடர்பு கொள்வதன் மூலம் நிகழலாம்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    III. ஹெபடைடிஸ் டி பொதுவாக ஹெபடைடிஸ் ஏ போலவே அசுத்தமான உணவு மற்றும் நீர் மூலம் பெறப்படுகிறது.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    மேலே கொடுக்கப்பட்ட அறிக்கைகளில் எத்தனை சரியானவை?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "ஒன்று மட்டும்"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "இரண்டு மட்டும்"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "மூன்றும்"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "எதுவுமில்லை"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is Option 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Statement I: Hepatitis means inflammation of the liver. It is not caused only by hepatotropic viruses. Apart from hepatitis viruses, it may also be caused by alcohol, certain drugs, toxins, autoimmune diseases and other infections. Hence, Statement I is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Statement II: Hepatitis B spreads through contact with infected blood and certain body fluids such as semen and vaginal fluids. Hepatitis D also spreads in a similar manner, because Hepatitis D virus infection occurs only in persons infected with Hepatitis B virus. Hence, Statement II is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Statement III: Hepatitis D is not typically transmitted through contaminated food and water. Food-and-water transmission is mainly associated with Hepatitis A and Hepatitis E. Hepatitis A spreads when a person ingests food or water contaminated with faeces of an infected person. Hence, Statement III is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Therefore, only one statement is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hepatitis is a broad term meaning inflammation of the liver. It may be caused by hepatitis viruses, alcohol, toxins, certain medicines, autoimmune conditions and some other infections. Therefore, every case of hepatitis is not necessarily viral hepatitis.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The five major hepatitis viruses are Hepatitis A, B, C, D and E. They differ mainly in their route of transmission, tendency to become chronic, availability of vaccines and risk of long-term complications.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hepatitis A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Contaminated food/water; direct contact with infected person

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Vaccine available

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hepatitis B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Blood, semen and other body fluids; mother-to-child transmission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can become chronic

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Vaccine available

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hepatitis C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Mainly infected blood exposure

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Often becomes chronic

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No effective vaccine

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hepatitis D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Blood/body fluids, but only with Hepatitis B infection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can become severe/chronic

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Prevented indirectly through Hepatitis B vaccine

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hepatitis E

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Contaminated food/water

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Usually acute, but may be severe in pregnancy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Vaccine exists in limited contexts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hepatitis A and Hepatitis E are commonly linked with the faeco-oral route, especially unsafe food, unsafe water and poor sanitation. Hepatitis A usually causes an acute illness, and most infected persons recover completely with lifelong immunity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hepatitis B is important because it can spread through infected blood, semen and other body fluids, and it may also pass from mother to child during birth. Chronic Hepatitis B can lead to cirrhosis and liver cancer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hepatitis D is unique because it is a defective virus. It cannot establish infection independently and requires Hepatitis B virus for its life cycle. Therefore, Hepatitis D infection occurs only in persons who are already infected with Hepatitis B or who acquire Hepatitis B and D together.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • There are two important patterns of Hepatitis D infection. Co-infection occurs when a person gets Hepatitis B and Hepatitis D at the same time. Superinfection occurs when a person already having chronic Hepatitis B later acquires Hepatitis D. Superinfection is usually more dangerous and may accelerate progression to cirrhosis and liver failure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Hepatitis B vaccine also helps prevent Hepatitis D because Hepatitis D depends on Hepatitis B. Thus, vaccination against Hepatitis B is an important preventive measure against both Hepatitis B and Hepatitis D.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
